description: This file contains the implementation of a multi-region client for Amazon S3 in PHP, extending the base AWS MultiRegionClient. It provides methods for region determination, caching, and presigned request creation for S3 operations tailored to multiple regions within AWS.

classes.name: S3MultiRegionClient
classes.description: A specialized AWS S3 client that supports multi-region operations with region determination and caching capabilities.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Extends parent arguments with default region and bucket region cache configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the client, setting up the cache and middleware for region determination.

methods.name: determineRegionMiddleware
methods.description: Returns middleware that determines the region for a bucket, utilizing cache and handling redirects or errors.

methods.name: createPresignedRequest
methods.description: Creates a presigned request for a specific command on an S3 bucket, ensuring a bucket is specified.

methods.name: getObjectUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL for accessing an object in a specific bucket by resolving the regional client.

methods.name: determineBucketRegionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously determines the region for a given bucket, using cache if available.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on the bucket name for region caching.
